(2) A close-up view shows a hand sprinkling a generous amount of grated white cheese over the large pile of fusilli pasta which is coated in a rich, reddish-brown meat sauce. (3) A bald man in a black t-shirt with a nautical compass logo smiles while standing next to a table in the restaurant; posters of Campari are visible on the green-walled background. (4) A young man with glasses and a red-and-white checkered cloth tied around his neck sits at a table, looking determined as he prepares to eat. (5) A white digital timer is shown close-up, set to 30:00 minutes before being started by a finger press. (6) In a commercial kitchen, a chef tosses pasta in a wok over a high-flame burner, creating a burst of fire while adding red meat sauce. (7) A promotional sign titled 'MAN VS PASTA CHALLENGE' details the rules for the big eater contest. (8) A montage shows the young man eating the pasta with increasing effort while the bald man ties his bib. (9) The plate is shown nearly empty with only streaks of sauce remaining. (10) The bald man excitedly checks the timer and celebrates with the young man. (11) A black voucher for a $2000 coupon is held up by a hand. (12) The video concludes with an exterior shot of the restaurant at night with address text overlays.

(3) A digital 'beep' marks the start of the 30-minute timer. Sizzling and whooshing flame sounds are heard as the narrator explains ingredients.
